summary: GitHub MCP publications must include the github-pp-mcp command entrypoint whenever MCP artifacts are advertised.
reason: The generated package included manifest.json, tools-manifest.json, release config, and docs for github-pp-mcp, but omitted cmd/github-pp-mcp/main.go; the published MCPB contract and go install path fail without the binary entrypoint.
validated_outcome: python3 .github/scripts/verify-manifest/verify_manifest.py passes for library/developer-tools/github after restoring the entrypoint.
